profile.headline: Software and Systems Engineer
profile.summary: Accomplished professional with a passion for problem-solving and technology-driven solutions. With a successful track record in diverse roles, I am looking for my next role where I can leverage my experience to have a strong impact and drive innovation. My career has equipped me with a unique blend of skills that bridge business development, project management, and data analysis, making me a valuable asset in the software engineering and financial landscape.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.insights: Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), Operations Management and +4 skills

positions.title: Software Operations Engineer
positions.description:
* Intelligent transportation systems provider for software systems behind tolling transactions on various 
   highways.
* Provided L2 support across Linux based servers that monitored and captured transactions across the 
   tollways.
* Enhanced key performance indicators measuring missed transactions by providing data analysis tools 
   via SQL and Python, thereby enabling the system monitoring team to rapidly identify sub-performing 
   transaction zones and get support tickets sent out faster.
* Provided on-demand support for clients using the flagship transaction software product.
* Provided product documentation and script tools to automate troubleshooting.

Key Accomplishments:
* Eliminated 90% of lost revenue due to unprocessed transactions over a 6-month period.
* Reduced server maintenance resolution time by over 67% via automation.
* Helped develop a web application trouble shooting system that reduced engineering support
   requests by nearly 70%.
positions.insights: API Development, Financial Transactions and +4 skills

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
* Worked alongside government stakeholders to identify top-level requirements based on mission 
   parameters and defined these requirements at each level from system architecture down to individual 
   component requirements. Tasked with tracing around 500 requirements. 
* Collectively worked on comprehensive system requirements document with 20 internal stakeholders 
   from various team functions, contributing to about 25% of the total document.
* Created and managed a task scheduling process for the 60-person systems engineering team for the 
   full extent of the preliminary design phase, ensuring all contract deliverables were met on schedule.
* Recognized for exceptional team performance and contributions to the preliminary design phase of 
   the program.
* Lead the development of the Item Unique Identification Document for the B-52 Radar Program, 
   involving logistics planning to store and transport high value system components.

Key Accomplishments
* Identified and wrote about 100 missing specifications across 4-5 different internal teams.
* Reduced delayed deliverables by 80%.
* Recognized as atop 10% company-wide performer during performance review
* Influenced the customer and internal logistics teams to provide a contract change order to 
   include  an RFID labeling system, expected to reduce required warehouse labor by 50%
positions.insights: Client Relations, Project Management and +3 skills

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
* Developed composite materials for oil pipeline surveillance UAVs
* Built investor relations to ensure product integrity

projects.title: Stock Market Options Analysis and Alert Application
projects.description: Ongoing individual project to develop a program that monitors a stream of stock market options data throughout the day, notifying the end user if any unusual activity has been found. Application connects to a brokerage API via socket connection and provides statistical analysis, using concurrency and low-latency design methods to ensure alerts are created and notified as fast as possible

projects.title: Reddit Stock Traffic Analyzer
projects.description: Project using NodeJs and mySQL to track stock talk and sentiment on the reddit Wall St Bets forum.
